local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- НАСТРОЙКИ
local FOV_RADIUS = 150
local MIN_FOV = 50
local MAX_FOV = 400

local AimLockEnabled = false
local ESPEnabled = false
local WallCheckEnabled = true
local FOVEnabled = true

local Highlights = {}

-- GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AimLockGUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ПАНЕЛЬ
local Panel = Instance.new("Frame")
Panel.Parent = ScreenGui
Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 260)
Panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.7, 0)
Panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
Panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
Panel.Active = true

local PanelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
PanelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
PanelCorner.Parent = Panel

-- ФУНКЦИЯ СОЗДАНИЯ КНОПОК
local function CreateButton(text, position, size)
	local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	Button.Parent = Panel
	Button.Size = size
	Button.Position = position
	Button.Text = text
	Button.TextScaled = true
	Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Button.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	Corner.Parent = Button

	return Button
end

-- AIMLOCK
local AimButton = CreateButton(
	"AimLock: HOLD RMB",
	UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5),
	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

-- ESP
local ESPButton = CreateButton(
	"ESP: OFF",
	UDim2.fromOffset(5, 50),
	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

-- WALL CHECK
local WallButton = CreateButton(
	"WallCheck: ON",
	UDim2.fromOffset(5, 95),
	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

WallButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

-- FOV
local FOVButton = CreateButton(
	"FOV: ON",
	UDim2.fromOffset(5, 140),
	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

FOVButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

-- КНОПКА ЗАКРЫТИЯ
local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseButton.Parent = Panel
CloseButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -33, 0, 5)
CloseButton.Text = "X"
CloseButton.TextScaled = true
CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
CloseButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseButton.BorderSizePixel = 0

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseButton

-- FOV SLIDER
local SliderBackground = Instance.new("Frame")
SliderBackground.Parent = Panel
SliderBackground.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 6)
SliderBackground.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 195)
SliderBackground.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
SliderBackground.BorderSizePixel = 0

local SliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
SliderCorner.Parent = SliderBackground

local SliderButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
SliderButton.Parent = SliderBackground
SliderButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
SliderButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

local StartPercent =
	(FOV_RADIUS - MIN_FOV) / (MAX_FOV - MIN_FOV)

SliderButton.Position = UDim2.new(StartPercent, 0, 0.5, 0)
SliderButton.Text = ""
SliderButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SliderButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
SliderButton.AutoButtonColor = false

local SliderButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SliderButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
SliderButtonCorner.Parent = SliderButton

-- ТЕКСТ FOV
local FOVLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
FOVLabel.Parent = Panel
FOVLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
FOVLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 205)
FOVLabel.Text = "FOV: " .. FOV_RADIUS
FOVLabel.TextScaled = true
FOVLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- ПЕРЕТАСКИВАНИЕ ПАНЕЛИ
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

Panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Panel.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		Panel.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

-- ЗАКРЫТИЕ ПАНЕЛИ
CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Panel.Visible = false
end)

-- RIGHT SHIFT ОТКРЫТЬ / ЗАКРЫТЬ
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		Panel.Visible = not Panel.Visible
	end
end)

-- FOV КРУГ
local FOVCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
FOVCircle.Parent = ScreenGui
FOVCircle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
FOVCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVCircle.BorderSizePixel = 0

local CircleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CircleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
CircleCorner.Parent = FOVCircle

local CircleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
CircleStroke.Parent = FOVCircle
CircleStroke.Thickness = 2
CircleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local function UpdateFOV()
	FOVCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
		FOV_RADIUS * 2,
		FOV_RADIUS * 2
	)

	FOVLabel.Text = "FOV: " .. math.floor(FOV_RADIUS)
end

UpdateFOV()

-- SLIDER
local sliderDragging = false

local function SetSliderFromX(x)
	local left = SliderBackground.AbsolutePosition.X
	local width = SliderBackground.AbsoluteSize.X

	local percent = math.clamp(
		(x - left) / width,
		0,
		1
	)

	FOV_RADIUS =
		MIN_FOV + (MAX_FOV - MIN_FOV) * percent

	SliderButton.Position =
		UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)

	UpdateFOV()
end

SliderButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
	sliderDragging = true
end)

SliderBackground.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		sliderDragging = true
		SetSliderFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if sliderDragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then

		SetSliderFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		sliderDragging = false
	end
end)

-- AIMLOCK: РАБОТАЕТ ПОКА ЗАЖАТА ПКМ
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		AimLockEnabled = true
		AimButton.Text = "AimLock: ON"
		AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		AimLockEnabled = false
		AimButton.Text = "AimLock: HOLD RMB"
		AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
end)

-- ПРОВЕРКА ВИДНОСТИ
local function IsVisible(Character, Head)
	local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = Head.Position - origin

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		LocalPlayer.Character
	}

	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

	if result then
		return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(Character)
	end

	return false
end

-- ПОИСК ЦЕЛИ
local function GetClosestHead()
	local closestHead = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge

	local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize

	-- Такой же центр, как у круга
	local screenCenter = Vector2.new(
		viewport.X / 2,
		viewport.Y / 2 - 35
	)

	for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then

			local Character = Player.Character
			local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local Humanoid =
				Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local position, onScreen =
					Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

				if onScreen then
					local screenPosition =
						Vector2.new(position.X, position.Y)

					local distance =
						(screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude

					local insideFOV = true

					if FOVEnabled then
						insideFOV = distance <= FOV_RADIUS
					end

					if insideFOV then
						local canAim = true

						if WallCheckEnabled then
							canAim = IsVisible(Character, Head)
						end

						if canAim and distance < shortestDistance then
							shortestDistance = distance
							closestHead = Head
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closestHead
end

-- ESP
local function AddESP(Player)
	if Player == LocalPlayer then return end
	if not ESPEnabled then return end
	if not Player.Character then return end

	if Highlights[Player] then
		Highlights[Player]:Destroy()
	end

	local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	Highlight.Name = "PlayerESP"
	Highlight.Adornee = Player.Character
	Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
	Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	Highlight.Parent = Player.Character

	Highlights[Player] = Highlight
end

local function RemoveESP(Player)
	if Highlights[Player] then
		Highlights[Player]:Destroy()
		Highlights[Player] = nil
	end
end

local function ToggleESP()
	ESPEnabled = not ESPEnabled

	if ESPEnabled then
		ESPButton.Text = "ESP: ON"
		ESPButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

		for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			AddESP(Player)
		end
	else
		ESPButton.Text = "ESP: OFF"
		ESPButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)

		for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			RemoveESP(Player)
		end
	end
end

ESPButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleESP)

-- WALL CHECK
WallButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	WallCheckEnabled = not WallCheckEnabled

	if WallCheckEnabled then
		WallButton.Text = "WallCheck: ON"
		WallButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)
	else
		WallButton.Text = "WallCheck: OFF"
		WallButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
end)

-- FOV ON / OFF
FOVButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	FOVEnabled = not FOVEnabled

	if FOVEnabled then
		FOVButton.Text = "FOV: ON"
		FOVButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

		FOVCircle.Visible = true
		SliderBackground.Visible = true
		SliderButton.Visible = true
		FOVLabel.Visible = true
	else
		FOVButton.Text = "FOV: OFF"
		FOVButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)

		FOVCircle.Visible = false
		SliderBackground.Visible = false
		SliderButton.Visible = false
		FOVLabel.Visible = false
	end
end)

-- НОВЫЕ ИГРОКИ И РЕСПАВН
local function SetupPlayer(Player)
	if Player == LocalPlayer then return end

	Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.5)

		if ESPEnabled then
			AddESP(Player)
		end
	end)
end

for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	SetupPlayer(Player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(SetupPlayer)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	RemoveESP(Player)
end)

-- ОСНОВНОЙ ЦИКЛ
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize

	-- КРУГ ЧУТЬ ВЫШЕ ЦЕНТРА
	FOVCircle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
		viewport.X / 2,
		viewport.Y / 2 - 35
	)

	-- AIMLOCK
	if AimLockEnabled then
		local Head = GetClosestHead()

		if Head then
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(
				Camera.CFrame.Position,
				Head.Position
			)
		end
	end
end)

end

local function startFlying()
	character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
	
	local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end
	
	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	bv.Parent = hrp
	
	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
	bg.Parent = hrp
	
	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
		
		-- 1. Noclip Loop
		if _G.isNoclip then
			for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide == true then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
		
		-- 2. Thumbstick Logic (Horizontal Only)
		local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local flatVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		
		if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z).Unit
			local flatRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
			flatRight = Vector3.new(flatRight.X, 0, flatRight.Z).Unit
			
			local localMoveDirection = camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(moveDirection)
			flatVelocity = (flatLook * -localMoveDirection.Z) + (flatRight * localMoveDirection.X)
			
			if flatVelocity.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatVelocity = flatVelocity.Unit * _G.flySpeed
			end
		end
		
		-- 3. Button Logic (Vertical Only)
		local verticalVelocityY = _G.verticalDirection * _G.flySpeed
		
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(flatVelocity.X, verticalVelocityY, flatVelocity.Z)
		
		-- 4. Dynamic Tilt Engine (Faces camera look view)
		local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + camLook)
	end)
end

	local relativeX = input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
	local percentage = math.clamp(relativeX / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
	sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
	_G.flySpeed = math.round(percentage * _G.maxSpeed)
	if _G.flySpeed < 5 then _G.flySpeed = 5 end
	speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. _G.flySpeed

	local upper = char and char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	local neck = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Neck")
	local waist = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Waist")
	if neck then neck.Transform = CFrame.identity end

local function clearLook()

end

local function clearWind()
	for _, obj in ipairs(windBits) do
		if obj then obj:Destroy() end
	end
	windBits = {}
	if windSound then
		windSound:Stop()
		windSound:Destroy()
		windSound = nil
	end
	windShowing = false
end

local function clearPose()
	for _, ik in ipairs(ikList) do
		if ik then ik:Destroy() end
	end
	ikList = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(poseParts) do
		if part then part:Destroy() end
	end

local function makeTarget(parent, offset)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "InvisibleFlyTarget"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Anchored = false
	part.Massless = true
	part.Parent = parent
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Part0 = parent
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(offset)
	weld.Parent = part
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	table.insert(poseParts, part)

	if not endPart or not rootPart or not target then return end
	local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
	ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position
	ik.EndEffector = endPart
	ik.ChainRoot = rootPart
	ik.Target = target
	if pole then ik.Pole = pole end
	ik.Weight = 1
	ik.SmoothTime = 0.05
	ik.Parent = hum

	local leftHand = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-1.15, 2.8, 0.05))

	flying = false
	stage = 0
	windLevel = 0
	btn.Text = "VOAR"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 140, 220)
	if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end

	clearPose()
	clearWind()
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.PlatformStand = false
			hum.AutoRotate = true
		end
	end
end

local function startFly()
	flying = true
	stage = 1
	btn.Text = "BOOST 1"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 210)

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false

	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = hrp

	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
	bg.P = 20000
	bg.D = 1500
	bg.Parent = hrp

	local hovering = false
	local flightPose = false

	flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp.Parent then
			stopFly()
			return
		end

		local camCF = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local move = hum.MoveDirection
		local moving = move.Magnitude > 0.05
		local speed = speeds[stage] or 55

		if moving then
			if windLevel > 0 and not windShowing then
				setWind(hrp, windLevel)
			end
			lockTorso(char)
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end

			local flyDir = (camCF.LookVector * move:Dot(flatLook)) + (camCF.RightVector * move:Dot(flatRight))
			if flyDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				flyDir = flyDir.Unit
				bv.Velocity = flyDir * speed
				bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + flyDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, 0)
				if lookPart then
					lookPart.Position = hrp.Position + flyDir * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				end
			end

			if hovering then
				clearPose()
				hovering = false
			end
			if not flightPose then
				applyFlightPose(char, hum)
				flightPose = true
			end
		else
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
			bg.CFrame = camCF
			if windShowing then
				local saved = windLevel
				clearWind()
				windLevel = saved
			end
			if flightPose then
				clearPose()
				flightPose = false
			end
			if not hovering then
				applyHoverPose(char, hum)
				hovering = true
			end
		end
	end)
end
